g.text: BC-04 Sales Commitment — Logical Database Design
CHECK: origin_type = PURCHASE_REQUEST iff purchase_request_id is present.
DIRECT_ORDER carries no Purchase Request reference.
PK = primary key | FK = local foreign key | required = NOT NULL.
Tenant, buyer relationship and SKU columns are typed cross-context IDs.
SalesOrder retains its own root identity through commitment_id.
